title: Playhead: overview curves and analysis-driven tools for music and game audio
description:
Playhead is a browser-based lab for playhead waveforms: a waveform overview plus calibrated feature lines (loudness, activity, tension, harshness, beats, sections and sound-event types) and nine cross-field descriptors taken from machine diagnostics, seismology, voice science, optimal transport, information theory, recurrence analysis and impact acoustics. The same analysis drives seven editing, mixing and mastering tools (clean-up for export, de-harsh, layer remix, attack and body, tension shaper, loop maker, variations), and every result is re-analysed.

The release contains the validation tooling behind the accompanying paper: analytic reference tests, label-free metamorphic self-checks for unlabelled libraries, threshold calibration with a held-out half and repeated random splits, an ESC-50 classification experiment with negative controls, and a comparison of each tool with a static EQ, an ideal dynamic EQ and ideal EQ automation.

The app runs entirely in the browser without dependencies (JavaScript, HTML, CSS); the batch tools use Node.js and the experiments Python. Live version: eigensoundlab.github.io/playhead.
notes: The results reported in README.md, experiments/ and paper/ were produced with this version. Third-party audio used in the experiments (ESC-50, Sonic Pi samples, librosa examples) is not included; tools/fetch-corpus.sh and experiments/esc50/README.md describe how to obtain it.
